-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Higgsfield API credentials and connectivity.

higgsfield-run.name: higgsfield-run
higgsfield-run.description: Run any model on Higgsfield. Supports text-to-image, image-to-video, and other AI generation models.

higgsfield-text-to-image.name: higgsfield-text-to-image
higgsfield-text-to-image.description: Generate images from text prompts using Seedream v4.

params.prompt: Text description of the image to generate
params.aspect_ratio: Aspect ratio of the generated image

higgsfield-image-to-video.name: higgsfield-image-to-video
higgsfield-image-to-video.description: Convert an image to video with motion. Supports various motion styles and camera movements.

params.prompt: Text description of the video to generate

higgsfield-soul-generate.name: higgsfield-soul-generate
higgsfield-soul-generate.description: Generate images with consistent character appearance using Soul. Great for creating multiple images of the same character.

params.prompt: Text description of the scene/pose for the character
params.reference_image: URL of the reference image for character consistency

higgsfield-get-prediction.name: higgsfield-get-prediction
higgsfield-get-prediction.description: Get the status and result of a prediction by ID.

params.wait: Wait for completion if still processing (default: false)

higgsfield-cancel-prediction.name: higgsfield-cancel-prediction
higgsfield-cancel-prediction.description: Cancel a queued or processing prediction.

higgsfield-list-models.name: higgsfield-list-models
higgsfield-list-models.description: List available models and their capabilities.

name: Higgsfield
description: Generate AI images and videos with Higgsfield - text-to-image, image-to-video, and consistent character generation with Soul.

changelog.notes: Initial release — generate images from text, turn images into videos, and create consistent characters with Soul
